generalCriterionList.description: In the Sanctioned Estimate, the item rates are showing inclusive of all applicable taxes but it is to be noted that rates are exclusive of taxes (GST).

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in the form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per the circular from Govt of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bengaluru dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, Amount put to Tender and ECV amounts are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive Tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public procurement (KPP) portal.
Royalty on construction materials and other applicable taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts, labor, hire charges of machinery equipment etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Further particulars, if any queries required to the Contractor, they can get from the office of the concerned Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Chitradurga during office hours on all working days.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
The Tenderer should furnish all necessary original documents mentioned in the bid document to the Executive engineer at the time of verification of documents during Technical Bid evaluation
The intending bidders are requested to note that they should abide by the instructions and conditions contained in the bid documents and further orders thereon.
Contractor has to upload the valid EPF registration copy.

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified on his own risk and cost.

Materials like bitumen, steel and cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the Quality Assurance Authority before commencement of the work.
Work shall be carried out according to relevant IS/IRC codes specifications depending on type of work.
The bidder has to establish field laboratory at the work site as per GO No:PWD/243/SEV/2013 Bengaluru dated:22.07.2014.

The contractor has to quote the same rate to the same items of work that is to be executed at different chainages. If in case, the contractor quotes different rates for the same item appearing at different places of BOQ then, the lowest quoted rate for the same items will be considered for that particular item for evaluation and payment.
The Defects Liability Period is 12 (Twelve) months, (passing one rainy season).
